title: CNC/BO/Exclude routing classifier (confidence-gated ML)
description: Validated LOO test (scripts/classify_cnc_bo.py): CNC recall 99%, Exclude 94%, BO 65% (balanced acc 86%, +11% vs base). BO bulk is a make/buy decision not in geometry; grating-type BO = extreme instance_count (>=64 clean rule). Plan: auto-route confident parts, flag low-confidence (ambiguous BO) for human review. Never silently mis-route (wrong NC output).

title: Rules: plate/formed-plate/section decision-tree classifier
description: Decision tree (validated features in app/pipeline/feature_extract.py): flat plate (fill~1, t_eff~dim_thin); hollow box (n_holes>=1); open rolled section (thk_max/t_eff>1.5); uniform-open -> angle vs formed plate. Rules beat ML here (crisp physics, few labels). Emit per-branch confidence; flag low-confidence for review. Wire into cnc_shape_analyser as the plate/section gate once validated.
notes:
Decision tree validated at 92.1% (266 labels): holes>=1->SECTION;
t_eff_thin_ratio>=0.45->PLATE; rule_type==section->SECTION; thk_max_over_teff>=1.5
->SECTION; else FORMED_PLATE. Logic lives in collate_candidates.predict() + 
scripts/eval_rules.py. STILL TODO: port into a real classifier module and wire
into cnc_shape_analyser as the plate/section gate (with confidence + low-conf flag).
Residual error is the unmatched angle-vs-formed boundary -> needs rw7.2 bend-radius.

title: Automated part classification (plate/formed/section + CNC/BO routing)
description: Two automation tracks discovered 2026-06-08/09. (1) Geometric subtype plate/formed-plate/section via explainable RULES. (2) CNC/Bought-out/Exclude routing via confidence-gated ML using the user's existing classifications as labels. Foundation built: feature_extract.py (incl. cross-section raster: holes/thickness), feature_export.py (dataset + aligned cnc_class), labelling gallery, eval scripts (train_designation.py, classify_cnc_bo.py).

title: Known catalogue-product BO detection (Unistrut, etc.)
description: Some bought-out items ARE confidently identifiable (unlike the general make/buy call). Unistrut = proprietary strut-channel (channel w/ inturned rolled lips), always BO, identifiable by name ('SUPP UNIST...') and by its distinctive cross-section. Build a small extensible 'known catalogue products' list mapping name/shape -> BOUGHT_OUT. CAVEAT: name match must be specific -- 'SUPP UNIST PLATE 2mm' is a CNC plate, not strut (rule: contains 'unist' AND NOT 'plate'). Start with name rules; add the rolled-lip channel shape detector for unnamed cases. Only 6 parts/3 names in current corpus but the pattern generalises.

title: Bent section class + detector (in-house section/tube bending)
description: Gap found 2026-06-09 reviewing gallery: a bent CHS handrail (curved tube, multiple bends) is made in-house but fits none of plate/formed-plate/straight-section/BO. It's a 5th class: BENT_SECTION, manufacturing route = section/tube bending. Signature: constant tube profile but curved/multi-bend centreline -> centreline_length (=volume/CSA) >> dim_long; slice perpendicular to bbox-long-axis is not a clean constant profile. Added 'Bent section' to the labelling gallery (collate_candidates.py). TODO: detection feature (centreline-to-envelope ratio / non-straight sweep) in feature_extract.py; add to decision tree + CNC sub-routing (cut / brake-bend / saw-drill / section-bend).

title: Label 300-part gallery; tune + validate rule classifier
description: Gallery at /outputs/stl/_formed_candidates/gallery.html (300 distinct geoms, 40 jobs, holes/thickness shown). User classifies section/plate/formed/bought-out; Export CSV -> app/pipeline/data/labels/verified.csv. 29 already labelled (9 formed, 6 section, 14 plate). Use to tune thresholds + measure rule accuracy.
close_reason: Done: ~290 parts labelled across 40 jobs (all 6 classes) -> verified.csv. Rule decision tree calibrated to 92.1% on the 266 geometric labels (SECTION 92% / PLATE 98% recall) via scripts/eval_rules.py. Gallery live-preview uses the same tree.

title: Bend-radius feature: rolled angle vs formed plate
description: The one geometric distinction left: rolled angle = sharp outer 90deg corner; formed plate = rounded outer bend (R>=gauge), arbitrary angle. Detect via convex cylindrical face parallel to extrusion (BRep face-type) or outer-corner radius in the cross-section raster. Add to feature_extract.py; validate against gallery labels.

title: Designation ID ground-truth gap
description: Fine-grained section designation ML blocked by labels: corpus part-names are CAM marks, not Tekla designations (classify_by_name matches ~0). Only ~2% carry verbose ISO/DIN/BS designations (noisy). Options: extend name parser for 'STD - SIZE - LENGTH' format; or manual verification. Library-NN designation matching is the fallback.

title: Recover bought-out training labels
description: BO under-represented (only ~196 distinct shapes with geometry). ~47% of BO labels (N1092 jobs) have NO STEP upload -> re-upload to recover. C25001 BO is mostly one grating-bar geometry x2000 instances (dedups to ~158). More balanced BO data would lift the 65% recall ceiling.
